name: Kawanishi (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kawanishi town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kawanishi, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1959.

features.role: Kawanishi town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character
